content.short: Fintopio is a CeDeFi wallet for sending crypto through Telegram, mobile apps, and the web.
content.description: Fintopio is a multi-platform CeDeFi wallet available through Telegram, iOS, Android, and web. Its site describes a wallet that lets users switch between custodial transactions and self-custody, send crypto by Telegram or X username, import wallets, swap assets, and manage NFTs and dApps. It supports TON alongside BTC, ETH, SOL, BSC, TRON, and other networks. Fintopio works as an access point for holding assets, signing transactions, connecting to apps, and moving funds across supported networks.
